# High Contrast Dark

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-high-contrast-dark)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-high-contrast-dark)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-high-contrast-dark)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-high-contrast-dark)

High Contrast Dark is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the High Contrast family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-high-contrast-dark codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `highContrastDark` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { highContrastDark } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-high-contrast-dark';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, highContrastDark],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `highContrastDark` | `Extension` |
| `highContrastDarkMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#000000` |
| Active line | `#151515` |
| Selection | `#1a3865` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#fe5dfb` | bold | 8.17:1 | 7.11:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#fe5dfb` | bold | 8.17:1 | 7.11:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#00ffff` | - | 16.75:1 | 14.56:1 | 9.32:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#ffffff` | - | 21.00:1 | 18.26:1 | 11.68:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#ffffff` | - | 21.00:1 | 18.26:1 | 11.68:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#ff9900` | - | 9.81:1 | 8.53:1 | 5.46:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#42a6ff` | - | 8.13:1 | 7.07:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#00ffff` | - | 16.75:1 | 14.56:1 | 9.32:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#ffff00` | - | 19.56:1 | 17.01:1 | 10.88:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#ffff00` | italic | 19.56:1 | 17.01:1 | 10.88:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#ff9900` | italic | 9.81:1 | 8.53:1 | 5.46:1 |
| String | `string` | `#00ff00` | - | 15.30:1 | 13.31:1 | 8.51:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#fe5dfb` | - | 8.17:1 | 7.11:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#ff9900` | - | 9.81:1 | 8.53:1 | 5.46:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#ff9900` | - | 9.81:1 | 8.53:1 | 5.46:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#ffffff` | - | 21.00:1 | 18.26:1 | 11.68:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#a1a1a1` | italic | 8.13:1 | 7.07:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Meta | `meta` | `#a1a1a1` | - | 8.13:1 | 7.07:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Tag | `tagName` | `#fe5dfb` | - | 8.17:1 | 7.11:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Attribute | `attributeName` | `#ffff00` | - | 19.56:1 | 17.01:1 | 10.88:1 |
| Heading | `heading` | `#fe5dfb` | bold | 8.17:1 | 7.11:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Emphasis | `emphasis` | `#fe5dfb` | italic | 8.17:1 | 7.11:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Strong | `strong` | `#ff9900` | bold | 9.81:1 | 8.53:1 | 5.46:1 |
| Link | `link` | `#fe5dfb` | 500, underline | 8.17:1 | 7.11:1 | 4.55:1 |
| URL | `url` | `#00ffff` | underline | 16.75:1 | 14.56:1 | 9.32:1 |
| Inserted | `inserted` | `#00ff00` | - | 15.30:1 | 13.31:1 | 8.51:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#ffffff` | background, active line, selection | 11.68:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#b0b0b0` | gutter | 9.68:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#ffff00` | background, active line | 17.01:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#00ffff` | background | 16.75:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `2px solid #00ffff` | background, active line | 14.56:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#00ff00, 2px solid #ffffff` | background (fill or outline) | 21.00:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#1a3865` | active line | 1.56:1 | Pass |
